item.title: Commission takes new steps to prepare Europeans for growing crisis risks
item.description: European Commission Press release Brussels, 03 Nov 2026 As Europe faces increasingly frequent and complex crises, the European Commission is stepping up efforts to strengthen preparedness across the EU. From helping citizens protect themselves during emergencies to ensuring that national civil protection systems can keep operating when disaster strikes, the EU is delivering concrete measures to make Europe more resilient.

item.title: Commission conditionally approves JD.com's acquisition of CECONOMY under the Foreign Subsidies Regulation
item.description: European Commission Press release Brussels, 03 Nov 2026 The European Commission has approved, under the Foreign Subsidies Regulation ('FSR'), the acquisition of CECONOMY AG ('CECONOMY') by JD.com, Inc. ('JD.com'). The approval is conditional upon full compliance with the commitments offered by the parties.

item.title: EU Roma Strategic Framework brings positive progress on Roma rights across the EU with further efforts needed
item.description: European Commission Press release Brussels, 03 Nov 2026 The European Commission has published the third implementation report on the EU Roma Strategic Framework, covering the period from June 2023 to March 2025. The report identifies how the framework is helping advance Roma equality, inclusion and participation across the Union, while also outlining the remaining challenges.

item.title: Joint statement by Executive Vice-President Virkkunen, High Representative Kallas and Commissioner McGrath ahead of the International Day to End Impunity for Crimes against Journalists
item.description: European Commission Statement Brussels, 01 Nov 2026 Violence against journalists undermines the very foundations of open, free and democratic societies. Yet across the world, journalists continue to be killed, tortured, harassed, detained and forced into exile simply for doing their job and holding power to account.
